whenToUse: News piles up while people are away, such as comments, deliveries, and approval requests.
People need to see notifications again that a toast showed once.
You need to tell read from unread.
whenNotToUse: The service rarely has notifications (an empty bell is just noise).
The notification is urgent and needs action now (use a banner or dialog).
It's the result of something just done (use a toast).

alternatives.name: Popover
alternatives.reason: Showing general information or settings that aren't notifications.

accessibility: Put the unread count in the button name ("Notifications, 3 unread") instead of relying on a red badge.
Connect the button to the panel with aria-expanded and aria-controls.
The panel opens as a non-modal dialog that takes focus; when Esc or an outside click closes it, focus returns to the bell.
Add visually hidden "(unread)" text to unread items so the blue dot's meaning comes across.
